final_answer.key_evidence_summary: Only paymentservice-57b96767-95rmd is the outlier in the pod sheet: RESTARTS 2 (14s ago) while all other 10 boutique pods show 0 restarts. Pod detail shows Last State Terminated, Reason: Error, Exit Code 137, and pod events bind the mechanism verbatim: 'Warning Unhealthy 1s (x7 over 81s) kubelet Liveness probe failed: timeout: failed to connect service "172.20.1.146:50052" within 1s: context deadline exceeded' followed by 'Normal Killing 21s (x2 over 61s) kubelet Container server failed liveness probe, will be restarted'. The container actually serves on 50051 (Port 50051/TCP, env PORT=50051, Service 50051->50051), but GetAppYAML(paymentservice) shows livenessProbe grpc port: 50052 while readinessProbe correctly uses 50051 -- the liveness probe targets a port with no listener, so it can never succeed and kubelet kills the container every failureThreshold, producing the restart loop. Exit 137 is the kubelet SIGKILL after liveness failure (Reason 'Error', not 'OOMKilled'), and the 128Mi limit is not implicated. checkoutservice (the caller) logs no errors and GetAlerts shows no metric anomalies, confirming a probe-driven kill loop rather than load or dependency failure.
